meta.label: Shoe repair and resoling
meta.attribution: Every option here is a way to get worn shoes or boots resoled or rebuilt instead of replaced. Scores are judgments made from each provider's own published price list, help page or order form, read in September 2026. They are not audited outcomes, and nothing here measures how well any of them does the work. The cost score is set by the stated price of a full sole replacement, with pounds and euros compared to dollars at a rough exchange rate, so it is a band and not a ranking to the last dollar. The ease score rewards walk-in or postal access, short stated waits and few conditions on which shoes qualify (ease of use, not disability access). The repairability score reflects how much of the shoe the most thorough service listed will renew, from a sole only to a full rebuild on the original last. Most factory programmes take only their own brand's shoes, so the practical choice is often set by what is in the wardrobe; Fred's Shoe Repair in the US and The Boot Repair Company in the UK take several brands by post, and Vibram's certified cobbler locator lists local shops for shoes with no factory programme. Where a provider publishes no price or no waiting time, that cell is left empty rather than estimated. Two routes people already use could not be scored. Timpson's pages refused automated reading, and L.L.Bean's boot repair pages were blocked or needed a browser to display, so no price or wait is quoted for either. Birkenstock's own statement on resoling was not found, so its sandals appear only through a mail-in repairer that describes itself as an authorised Birkenstock repair centre, which is that repairer's own claim. Prices change without much notice, and Allen Edmonds' order form states that its prices took effect on 1 January 2020, so check the linked page. Reviewed 2026-09. Suggest changes via Contribute.

criteria.label: Low price for a full sole replacement
Easy to get done: walk-in or post, short wait, few limits on which shoes qualify (ease of use, not disability access)
How completely the shoe is renewed, from a sole only to a full rebuild on the original last

products.name: Danner Recrafting
products.description: Factory resole or full rebuild of Danner boots at the brand's Portland recrafting department.

economical.note: Danner's recrafting page lists a Resole service at 100 to 140 dollars, which replaces the outsole and laces and reconditions the leather, and a Rebuild at 280 dollars.

accessibility.note: The page says boots are mailed to the Danner recrafting department in Portland or dropped off in person, with free shipping back and a current turnaround of 4 weeks from receipt. The page lists the styles it commonly recrafts, says the leather uppers must be free of holes and major cracking, and the Mountain 600 Leaf GTX qualifies only for a resole.

repairability.note: The Rebuild service on the same page replaces the outsole, midsole, insoles and laces, reconditions the leather, and repairs stitching and hardware, with liner, shank and heel counter replaced where applicable. It is the fullest scope among the programmes read.

products.name: Red Wing Repair Shop
products.description: Resole and repair of Red Wing, WORX and Irish Setter boots, through a Red Wing store or by post.

economical.note: Red Wing's repairs page lists a resole with oiling and new laces at 165 dollars, replacing heels only at 60 dollars, and a Premium Repair Package at 180 dollars.

accessibility.note: The page says to bring the printed repair form and the boots to a Red Wing store, or call or email for a free shipping label on services over 50 dollars. It repairs only boots made by Red Wing Shoe Company, and says not all of them can be resoled, so a customer should check the style first.

repairability.note: The Premium Repair Package includes a resole and heel, repair of broken hooks and eyelets, minor stitching, new laces and leather reconditioning, and the à la carte list adds gussets, zippers and collar lining. The page says only welt-construction boots can be repaired and boots with cracked insoles, torn uppers or worn-through linings usually cannot.

products.name: Allen Edmonds Recrafting
products.description: Mail-in recrafting of Allen Edmonds shoes, run by the brand's Recrafting Department in Port Washington, Wisconsin.

economical.note: Allen Edmonds' Recrafting order form lists a Standard package at 150 dollars, a Prestige package at 175 dollars, a Sneaker package at 100 dollars and a heel service at 50 dollars. The form says its prices took effect on 1 January 2020, so they may have changed.

accessibility.note: The form says only Allen Edmonds shoes can be recrafted, that one form goes with each pair, and that some styles may not be eligible. It says shoes with cut, torn, stained, cracked or scuffed uppers or bad linings may not be accepted, and it gives no turnaround time.

repairability.note: The Standard package on the form replaces heel bases, toplifts, outsoles, cork inlays, welting and laces and refinishes the uppers. The form says the welted leather insole and upper leather cannot be replaced, and that recrafting returns shoes to original manufacturing dimensions.

products.name: Crockett & Jones factory repairs
products.description: Factory re-welting, resoling and reheeling of Crockett & Jones shoes on their original lasts in Northampton, England.

economical.note: Crockett & Jones' repairs page prices a single leather or rubber sole at 180 pounds, 210 euros or 250 dollars, and a hand grade single leather sole at 195 pounds, 220 euros or 270 dollars.

accessibility.note: The page says factory repairs can take up to 10 weeks depending on the time of year, that a repair is arranged through an online form, a Crockett & Jones shop or a stockist, and that not all stockists offer the service. It says the department can usually resole well-cared-for shoes up to three times but is sometimes unable to complete a repair.

repairability.note: The page says the shoes are stripped down leaving the upper and insole intact, re-welted on the last they were made on, then resoled, reheeled and finished, with the uppers cleaned and polished. Linings, elastics, eyelets and refinishing can be added on request.

products.name: Loake Refurbishment
products.description: Factory sole and heel refurbishment of Loake Goodyear-welted shoes in Northamptonshire, for UK addresses.

economical.note: Loake's repairs page lists a Sole and Heel Refurbishment at 125 pounds and an Export Grade Refurbishment at 135 pounds, both marked UK delivery only.

accessibility.note: The page marks the service as United Kingdom only and describes it for Goodyear welted styles, ordered online. It gives no turnaround time and lists the factory's 2026 holiday dates.

repairability.note: The page says soles, heels and welts are renewed where required on the original last, the uppers are refinished by hand, and fresh laces are fitted. A separate heel-only refurbishment is offered for lighter work.

products.name: Rancourt & Co. resole and refurbish
products.description: Resole and refurbishment program for Rancourt & Co. shoes.

economical.note: Rancourt & Co.'s resole page lists a Resole for camp moc and boat soles at 80 dollars, a Premium Resole at 120 dollars and a Refurbishment at 150 dollars.

accessibility.note: The Premium Resole product page says the resoling service is for Rancourt & Co. shoes only and gives instructions for mailing the shoes with the order confirmation. The same page shows a current lead time of 10 to 12 weeks, worded as applying to an item that will be made for the customer.

products.name: LOWA resole
products.description: Factory resoling of LOWA boots with cemented soles, offered from Germany to a few neighbouring countries.

economical.note: LOWA's EU webshop resole page gives a price of 120 euros per pair in Germany, including 5 euros return shipping and VAT, with prices for other countries on request.

accessibility.note: The page says the service is available in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, with other countries on request. Warranty cases go through the dealer, and out-of-warranty shoes are posted insured to LOWA's service department in Jetzendorf.

repairability.note: The page says resoling is possible for shoes with a cemented construction, that the old sole is sanded off and a new one glued on, and that shoes with a GORE-TEX membrane may leak afterwards. Extra stitching and lining repairs cost 35 to 50 euros and are offered only together with a resole or heel replacement.

products.name: Dr. Martens Repairs
products.description: A UK mail-in repair site run by an authorised repair partner of Dr. Martens, which resoles and welts Dr. Martens boots.

economical.note: The repair shop lists Resole and Welt at 79.99 pounds with the Classic DMS sole, from 69.99 pounds with a Bex sole, and 89.99 pounds for a platform boot.

accessibility.note: The site describes itself as a Dr. Martens authorised repair partner with a nationwide UK service and free return shipping on UK mainland orders over 50 pounds. It does not state a turnaround time.

repairability.note: The shop lists resole and welt, upper repair, zip repair and cleaning and conditioning, with separate lists for welted boots, non-welted boots and sandals. It says original components are used where possible.

products.name: The Boot Repair Company
products.description: A Leeds workshop that repairs boots and shoes from many brands by post, including Danner, Lowa, Red Wing and Timberland.

accessibility.note: The company's how-it-works page says the customer picks a repair, posts the item to its Leeds unit and chooses return delivery at checkout, with the customer paying to send it in. Its brand list on the same site includes Birkenstock, Blundstone, Danner, Lowa, Red Wing, Solovair, Timberland and Vivobarefoot, and a site banner offers free return shipping with a code.

products.name: Revivo repairs for Vivobarefoot
products.description: The repair arm of Vivobarefoot, which resoles and deep-cleans its own shoes with a partner boot repair company.

accessibility.note: Vivobarefoot's support page says the repair service is offered only for Vivobarefoot shoes, in any condition, and that some styles cannot yet be resoled, naming Ababa, ESC Tempest, Stealth, Ryder, all Ultra and all kids styles.

repairability.note: A second Vivobarefoot support page lists a Resole, available in the UK and EU, and a Resole plus Refresh with a deep clean, available in the USA, EU and UK. It says repairs are done with a partner specialist boot repair company and gives no price.

products.name: Fred's Shoe Repair
products.description: A Peoria, Illinois cobbler that resoles many brands by mail, with packages for Birkenstock, Thorogood, Thursday, Sperry, Christian Louboutin and Saint Laurent.

economical.note: Fred's brand collection lists resole packages from 70 dollars for Birkenstock, 90 dollars for Sperry and 145 dollars for Thorogood and Thursday boots.

accessibility.note: Fred's Birkenstock page says it resoles by mail nationwide and that most mail-in repairs ship back within 2 to 4 weeks. The customer posts the sandals to its Peoria address and the shop confirms the choices on arrival.

repairability.note: The Birkenstock page offers soles only, or a full footbed resole with a new cork footbed and cork sealing. It describes no work beyond the sole and footbed.

products.name: Vibram-certified independent cobblers
products.description: Local shoe repair shops that Vibram lists by certification level, for shoes with no factory resole programme.

accessibility.note: Vibram's locator lets a customer search by address or shop name and filter by activity, brand partnership and certification level. It describes Diamond shops as using 100 per cent Vibram soles and Premium shops as using at least 80 per cent. The locator page itself gives no prices or waiting times.

products.name: Resoling Blundstone boots
products.description: Blundstone boots, whose injection-moulded soles the maker says often cannot be resoled.

accessibility.note: Blundstone's US support page says most of its boots have soles applied by liquid polyurethane injection into a mold, which means the footwear can often not be resoled successfully. It says the maker cannot guarantee the quality of the repairs some boot repairers offer.

repairability.note: The same page points customers who want a replaceable sole to its Heritage Series, which has a Goodyear welt sole that a new sole can be re-stitched onto. For the other ranges the page describes resoling as not part of the design.
